env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env CGO_ENABLED=0

# Selecting only one package must not bypass the module's language rule.
cd mixed
! logos list ./g
stderr '\[correctness::mixed_module\] module example.com/mixed has Go packages \(example.com/mixed/g\) and loGo/s packages \(example.com/mixed/l\)'
! logos list ./l
stderr '\[correctness::mixed_module\]'
! logos build ./g
stderr '\[correctness::mixed_module\]'
! logos build ./l
stderr '\[correctness::mixed_module\]'
go list ./g
stdout '^example.com/mixed/g$'

# The same check applies to a dependency whose other package is unimported.
cd ../client
! logos list .
stderr '\[correctness::mixed_module\] module example.com/mixed'

# A test-only package has a language kind even when no test is selected.
cd ../testonly
! logos list ./g
stderr '\[correctness::mixed_module\].*example.com/testonly/l'

# Package selection must use the active build tags and module boundaries.
cd ../clean
logos list ./g
stdout '^example.com/clean/g$'
! logos list -tags=extra ./g
stderr '\[correctness::mixed_module\].*example.com/clean/extra'

# An overlay-only sibling participates without being written to disk.
! logos list -overlay=overlay.json ./g
stderr '\[correctness::mixed_module\].*example.com/clean/virtual'
! exists virtual/p.lgo

-- mixed/go.mod --
module example.com/mixed

go 1.27
-- mixed/g/g.go --
package g

const Value = 1
-- mixed/l/l.lgo --
package l

const Value = 2
-- client/go.mod --
module example.com/client

go 1.27

require example.com/mixed v0.0.0

replace example.com/mixed => ../mixed
-- client/p.go --
package client

import "example.com/mixed/g"

const Value = g.Value
-- testonly/go.mod --
module example.com/testonly

go 1.27
-- testonly/g/g.go --
package g
-- testonly/l/l_test.lgo --
package l
-- clean/go.mod --
module example.com/clean

go 1.27
-- clean/g/g.go --
package g
-- clean/extra/p.lgo --
//go:build extra

package p
-- clean/ignored/p.lgo --
//go:build ignore

package p
-- clean/testdata/p.lgo --
package p
-- clean/_hidden/p.lgo --
package p
-- clean/.hidden/p.lgo --
package p
-- clean/vendor/example.com/unused/p.lgo --
package p
-- clean/nested/go.mod --
module example.com/nested

go 1.27
-- clean/nested/p.lgo --
package p
-- clean/overlay.json --
{"Replace":{"virtual/p.lgo":"../overlay-source"}}
-- overlay-source --
package p
